findings.severity: נמוך-בינוני; לפני שהמעצב עורך את קובץ הנוסחים
findings.what: the definition generalises partly: a fresh list (none in the fixture) 25/40, tier A 20/24 (N15 יישלח מספר מעקב, N16 תקבלו את מספר המעקב, N17 נשמור אתכם מעודכנים, N24 תשלח); two-word labels pass (חשבונית במייל, עדכונים ב-SMS, אישור במייל, התראות בוואטסאפ: X13, X17); false positives: a heading X: Y before a negation (K34, K36, Y3) and English negation (K37)
findings.fix: two-word exemption only when the other word is a field word; a tracking number as an object of send/receive; the מעודכנים idiom; תשלח with a message subject; a heading before a negation is a label; negation in the Latin rules; keep the fresh list as a held-out check

findings.what: the needs guard: IMPLIES misses תתאחר, קבלה, שוב במלאי, הטבות והנחות (N2, N4, N5, N6); needs "any" skips the guard and the gate allows the line with any provider (N7: the invoice line shown with order_confirmation only); a group split only by pairs of needs passes (N8b: the waitlist button without its submit under back_in_stock+marketing)
findings.fix: "any" only for a line whose promises imply nothing; widen IMPLIES; check groups and lines over all 64 sets

findings.what: the public build accepts placeholder addresses outside RFC 2606: shop@example.co.il, frontend-dev's own S20 test address shop@hd-test.co.il with 03-1234567 (the example in the error message), email@domain.com, info@yourdomain.co.il, test@test.co.il; behind the flag an example.com address gets no warning
findings.fix: a deny list of the team's own test values and common placeholders, an owner confirmation for the public build (CONTACT1), a warning behind the flag

findings.severity: נמוך; עם EMAIL1, לפני שהסיפור ציבורי
findings.what: the story sheet links to the story detail page (/story/.../p/<id>/), which never has the waiting-list form (make-story.ts writes none); when back_in_stock is real, story.unavailable_note returns and promises a form that is not on the page it links to
findings.fix: the form on the story detail page with the same group, or the note links to /p/<id>/; an e2e with a back_in_stock test provider that follows the link

findings.what: scanner: an array .join(" ") and String.concat are not read joined (X15, X16); a WebP's XMP is not read (X11: binary, not read by a customer)
findings.fix: rendered() reads .join(<literal>) and .concat(); the gate header lists binary metadata as not covered
